description: A Search — how a recall ranks, how many hits it returns and where it looks. Crystal runs it over what Mantle answers the caller may read; a Chat linked to a Search grounds through it, and a Chat with none runs the platform Search.

scope.description: collection ids the recall looks in; empty means everything the caller may read

size.description: how many hits the recall returns

rank.description: ordered rank keys: title (an exact title, then one the query begins), rarity (rarest matched words first), own (the caller's own artifacts), coverage (more matched words), recency

ui.label: Search
ui.description: A Search — rank, size and scope a recall runs with.
